mnemonic.meaning: 批 criticize + 評 evaluate: evaluating critically.
mnemonic.reading: "HEE, HYOU!" (ひひょう) He, the leopard critic.

examples.ja: 新聞に映画の批評が出た。
examples.en: A review of the film appeared in the paper.

items.note: Reviews of art and books. 批判 (ひはん) is criticism, usually negative.

mnemonic.meaning: 航 sail + 海 sea: sailing the sea.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, KAI!" (こうかい) Same sound as 後悔 (regret).

examples.ja: 船は長い航海に出た。
examples.en: The ship set out on a long voyage.

items.note: Sea travel. 航空 is air travel.

mnemonic.meaning: 化 change + 学 study: the study of change.
mnemonic.reading: "KA, GAKU!" (かがく) Same sound as 科学 (science).

examples.ja: 化学の実験は面白い。
examples.en: Chemistry experiments are interesting.

items.note: To avoid confusion, people say ばけがく for 化学.

mnemonic.meaning: 琴 has 王王 (jewels): a precious string instrument.
mnemonic.reading: "KOTO!" (こと) Same sound as 事 (thing).

examples.ja: 祖母は琴を弾く。
examples.en: My grandmother plays the koto.

items.note: A 13-string zither. 弾く (ひく) = play strings.

mnemonic.meaning: 大 big + 使 envoy: a high envoy.
mnemonic.reading: "TAI, SHE!" (たいし) She ties the ambassador's tie.

examples.ja: 彼は日本大使としてフランスに行った。
examples.en: He went to France as Japan's ambassador.

items.note: 大使館 = embassy.

mnemonic.meaning: 挿 has 扌 (hand): putting something in by hand.
mnemonic.reading: "SASU!" (さす) Same sound as 刺す and 射す (Level 20).

examples.ja: 花瓶に花を挿した。
examples.en: I put flowers in a vase.

items.note: 差す / 挿す both used. コンセントを差す = plug in.

mnemonic.meaning: 句 = 勹 (wrap) + 口 (mouth): words wrapped together. A phrase.
mnemonic.reading: "KU!" (く) Same く as 俳句 (haiku).

examples.ja: この句の意味を先生に聞いた。
examples.en: I asked the teacher what this verse meant.

items.note: 文句 (complaint), 句読点 (punctuation).

mnemonic.meaning: 覚 has 見 (see): making someone see again.
mnemonic.reading: "SAMASU!" (さます) Same sound as 冷ます (Level 1).

examples.ja: 大きな音で目を覚ました。
examples.en: A loud noise woke me up.

items.note: Transitive partner of 覚める (Level 14). 目を覚ます = to wake up.

mnemonic.meaning: 小 small + 麦 wheat: small grain. Wheat.
mnemonic.reading: "KO, MUGI!" (こむぎ) Note: 麦 becomes むぎ.

examples.ja: パンは小麦から作られる。
examples.en: Bread is made from wheat.

items.note: 小麦粉 = flour. 大麦 = barley.

mnemonic.meaning: 異 different + 動 move: moving to a different place.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, DOU!" (いどう) Same sound as 移動 (moving).

examples.ja: 四月に大阪支社へ異動になった。
examples.en: I was transferred to the Osaka branch in April.

items.note: For job transfers inside a company. 移動 is physically moving.

mnemonic.meaning: 図 drawing + 書 book: books and drawings.
mnemonic.reading: "TOSHO!" (としょ) Toe show at the library.

examples.ja: 図書館で本を借りた。
examples.en: I borrowed books from the library.

items.note: Mostly in 図書館 (library), 図書室.

mnemonic.meaning: 銅 copper + 貨 money: copper money.
mnemonic.reading: "DOU, KA!" (どうか) Same sound as どうか (please).

examples.ja: 古い銅貨を見つけた。
examples.en: I found an old copper coin.

items.note: 10円玉 is a 銅貨. 金貨 / 銀貨 = gold / silver coin.

mnemonic.meaning: 論 argument: making an argument.
mnemonic.reading: "RON, JIRU!" (ろんじる) Ron argues the point.

examples.ja: その問題について論じた。
examples.en: We discussed that issue.

items.note: Formal and academic. 話し合う is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: IRAIRA: the sound of nerves grating.

examples.ja: 電車が遅れていらいらした。
examples.en: I got irritated when the train was late.

items.note: Usually いらいらする. むかむか is anger or nausea.

mnemonic.meaning: 享 enjoy + 受 receive: receiving and enjoying.
mnemonic.reading: "KYOU, JUU!" (きょうじゅ) Same sound as 教授 (professor).

examples.ja: 私たちは科学の進歩の恩恵を享受している。
examples.en: We are enjoying the benefits of scientific progress.

items.note: Formal; enjoying rights or benefits. 楽しむ is everyday enjoyment.

mnemonic.meaning: 硬 hard + 貨 money: hard money.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, KA!" (こうか) Same sound as 高価 (Level 12) and 効果.

examples.ja: 自動販売機に硬貨を入れた。
examples.en: I put coins into the vending machine.

items.note: Formal word for coins. 小銭 (Level 20) is small change. 紙幣 = banknote.

mnemonic.meaning: 技 skill + 師 expert: a skilled expert.
mnemonic.reading: "GI, SHE!" (ぎし) Gee, she's an engineer.

examples.ja: 彼は電気技師だ。
examples.en: He's an electrical engineer.

items.note: Slightly old; エンジニア / 技術者 are common now.

mnemonic.meaning: 引 pull + 用 use: pulling words out to use.
mnemonic.reading: "IN, YOU!" (いんよう) Same sound as 陰陽 (yin and yang).

examples.ja: 論文に有名な言葉を引用した。
examples.en: I quoted a famous saying in my paper.

items.note: 引用文 = a quotation.

mnemonic.meaning: 上 up + 京 capital: going up to the capital.
mnemonic.reading: "JOU, KYOU!" (じょうきょう) Same sound as 状況 (situation).

examples.ja: 彼は十八歳で上京した。
examples.en: He moved to Tokyo at eighteen.

items.note: Going to Tokyo from elsewhere in Japan, usually to live.

mnemonic.meaning: 宛 has 宀 (roof): sending to someone's house.
mnemonic.reading: "ATERU!" (あてる) Same sound as 当てる (hit).

examples.ja: 母に宛てて手紙を書いた。
examples.en: I wrote a letter addressed to my mother.

items.note: Usually 〜に宛てて. 宛先 = address, recipient. 〜宛 on envelopes = "to".

mnemonic.meaning: 霜 has 雨 (rain) on top: frozen moisture.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIMO!" (しも) She moans: it's frosty.

examples.ja: 今朝は畑に霜が降りた。
examples.en: There was frost on the fields this morning.

items.note: 霜が降りる = frost forms. 霜焼け = chilblains.

mnemonic.meaning: 横 side + 断 cut: cutting across sideways.
mnemonic.reading: "OU, DAN!" (おうだん) Oh, Dan crosses. Note: 横 is おう here.

examples.ja: 横断歩道を渡ってください。
examples.en: Please use the pedestrian crossing.

items.note: 横断歩道 = crosswalk. Also crossing a continent: アメリカ横断.

mnemonic.meaning: 起 start + 源 source: where it started.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, GEN!" (きげん) Same sound as 機嫌 (mood) and 期限 (deadline).

examples.ja: この祭りの起源は古い。
examples.en: This festival has old origins.

items.note: Formal. 始まり (Level 7) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 公 fair + 正 just: fair and just.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, SAY!" (こうせい) Same sound as 構成 (composition) and 校正 (proofreading).

examples.ja: 公正な判断をお願いします。
examples.en: Please make a fair judgement.

items.note: Formal; justice and rules. 公平 (Level 15) is treating everyone equally.

mnemonic.meaning: 慣 has 忄 (heart): getting your heart used to something.
mnemonic.reading: "NARASU!" (ならす) Same sound as 鳴らす (Level 6).

examples.ja: 新しい靴を少しずつ足に慣らした。
examples.en: I gradually broke in my new shoes.

items.note: Transitive of 慣れる. 体を慣らす = to get your body used to something.

mnemonic.meaning: KAYUI: "Ka, you-ee!" A mosquito (蚊, か) made you itchy.

examples.ja: 蚊に刺されたところがかゆい。
examples.en: My mosquito bite is itchy.

items.note: Kanji: 痒い. かゆみ = itchiness.

mnemonic.meaning: 賞 prize + 品 article: a prize article.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOU, HIN!" (しょうひん) Same sound as 商品 (goods for sale).

examples.ja: 一位の賞品は自転車だった。
examples.en: The first prize was a bicycle.

items.note: An object given as a prize. 賞金 = prize money. 商品 = merchandise.

mnemonic.meaning: 穀 grain + 物 thing: grain things.
mnemonic.reading: "KOKU, MOTSU!" (こくもつ) Coke and grains.

examples.ja: 米や麦などの穀物を育てている。
examples.en: They grow grains like rice and wheat.

items.note: Formal. Rice, wheat, corn, beans.

mnemonic.meaning: 発 depart + 車 vehicle: the vehicle departs.
mnemonic.reading: "HASSHA!" (はっしゃ) Same sound as 発射 (launch, firing).

examples.ja: 電車はまもなく発車します。
examples.en: The train will depart shortly.

items.note: Vehicles leaving. 出発 is anyone departing. 発車時刻 = departure time.

mnemonic.meaning: 茹 has 艹 (plant): boiling vegetables.
mnemonic.reading: "YUDERU!" (ゆでる) You, dare to boil the eggs.

examples.ja: 卵を十分間茹でた。
examples.en: I boiled the eggs for ten minutes.

items.note: Usually in kana: ゆでる. ゆで卵 = boiled egg. 煮る (Level 18) is simmering with seasoning.
